name: Task stoppedReason classes
description: DescribeTasks returns stoppedReason as a free-form string but it follows recognizable patterns: 'Essential container in task exited' (app crash), 'CannotPullContainerError' (image fetch — auth/network/missing), 'ResourceInitializationError' (CNI/EFS/Secrets failed pre-launch), 'OutOfMemoryError' (cgroup OOM), 'Task failed ELB health checks' (LB-driven kill), 'Scaling activity initiated by deployment' (scheduler intentional), 'Spot capacity not available' (Fargate Spot interruption), 'Task stopped by user'.

name: CannotPullContainerError taxonomy
description: Sub-classes: (a) auth — invalid ECR token, missing repositoryCredentials, executionRoleArn lacks ecr:GetAuthorizationToken; (b) network — task subnet has no NAT/internet egress, VPC endpoint missing for ECR; (c) image-not-found — wrong tag/sha, image deleted, wrong region; (d) rate-limited — Docker Hub anonymous-pull rate exceeded, ECR throttled. Surface: stoppedReason in DescribeTasks.

name: ResourceInitializationError taxonomy
description: Pre-launch failures attaching task resources. Sub-classes: ENI attach timeout (subnet IP exhaustion, ENI quota, awsvpc-trunking not enabled), EFS mount failed (transit-encryption mismatch, SG blocking 2049, fileSystem ID typo), Secret resolution failed (executionRole lacks secretsmanager:GetSecretValue or kms:Decrypt; bad ARN), CNI plugin failed (agent log /var/log/ecs/ecs-agent.log shows 'plugin failed').

name: Task placement failure (RESOURCE:* + ATTRIBUTE)
description: Returned synchronously from RunTask (in failures[]). Reasons: 'RESOURCE:CPU' (no instance has enough free CPU), 'RESOURCE:MEMORY', 'RESOURCE:PORTS' (host network port conflict), 'RESOURCE:ENI' (awsvpc ENI quota hit), 'RESOURCE:GPU', 'ATTRIBUTE:ecs.<x>' (no instance matches placementConstraints), 'AGENT' (agent disconnected from instance).

name: Service event log deciphering
description: DescribeServices returns events[] (last 100). Patterns: 'service X has reached a steady state' (good), 'service X was unable to place a task' (placement failure — see task-placement-failure), 'service X has stopped 3 running tasks' (LB unhealthy → scheduler kill), 'service X is unable to consistently start tasks successfully' (deployment circuit breaker tripped). Time-correlate with task stoppedReason for full picture.
